player_prompt.intro:
Ove uwele Mwimbangi {player_id} mu joga ya Rock-Paper-Scissors ya mavu {num_rounds}.
Ondaka yawe ni kuvinga mavu mengi kweli.
Mu mavu yayili yose, yamukwamo ndawu mosi ya: '[rock]', '[paper]', kana '[scissors]'.
Ove wete kutumisa '[r]', '[p]', kana '[s]' ndawu ya kufupisha.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kimbila kya kuimbanga kayi kuyitawama. Tumisa [rock], [paper], kana [scissors].

message.round_draw: Oku imba ombunje: Ka va kuatele u wa ci linga.

outcome.p0_wins: Omunu wa yulula, eye o kuete ondimbukiso yaco.
outcome.p1_wins: Omunu watete, o tambula ekolowa liuvangi weci ca pita!
